name: Growing pipes
description: Three glossy tubes in tan, steel blue and paper grow at right angles through a navy disc, with ball joints at every turn, after the classic pipes screensaver.
choices: Right-angle growth, ball joints and over-under crossings carry the screensaver into a round badge
Primary colours are replaced with brand-friendly tan, steel and paper on navy
motion: Plays once on load: the pipes grow segment by segment over about four seconds, then hold.
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
